name_reason: Fully compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global) + battle domain (character/job core table, sibling of data_fd2_battle_movement_cost_table / _job_allowed_items_table in the same home file btltab3.c) + descriptor class_promotion_data_table that reflects both purpose (class-promotion result data) and data shape (table). No Ghidra address residue: the name has no numeric suffix at all (the only numbers nearby, 0x615FE, appear in the comment as a location tag, which is permitted). The minor 'data_table' redundancy is harmless and accurately signals a lookup table; not a defect warranting rename.
purpose: Class-promotion result table for the church/promotion service. Given a promoted-class portrait id (target_class_id in 0x20..0x43), the accessor fd2_get_class_promotion_data_entry @ 0x4E48D returns &table[(class_id - 0x20)*2]; callers read byte[0] = the job_id the character receives on promotion, and byte[1] = the spell id the character learns on promotion (0 = none).
logic_summary: 72-byte const array = 36 entries x 2 bytes, indexed by (target_class_id - 0x20). Accessor fd2_get_class_promotion_data_entry @ 0x4E48D: SUB EAX,0x20; SHL EAX,1; LEA EDX,[0x615FE]; ADD EAX,EDX; RET -- i.e. base 0x615FE (the symbol address) + index*2 (Ghidra's decompiler renders the LEA immediate as data_orphan_615fd+1 purely because it anchored a label one byte earlier at 0x615FD; the machine code loads 0x615FE directly, so the C [72] array starting at this symbol is exact). Three readers, all via the accessor: (1) fd2_run_class_promotion_menu_main @ 0x31385 writes rt_chars[idx].bJob_id = *promo_entry (byte[0] = new job); (2) fd2_execute_class_promotion_with_dialog @ 0x31602 reads promo_entry[1] and, if non-zero, shows the learn-spell dialog and appends it to the character's spell list (pCombat_aux_block[0x14] += (char)promo_entry[1]); (3) fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid @ 0x31019 shows the post-promotion class info in the selection UI before commit. Index upper bound 0x43 is set by fd2_build_promotion_candidates_with_targets @ 0x31793 (target = portrait_id+0x20 default / +0x32 alt key-item path / 0x34 Lord; portrait_id in [0,0x12), max = 0x11+0x32 = 0x43). Table occupies 0x615FE..0x61646, immediately followed by data_fd2_battle_movement_cost_table @ 0x61646; the preceding data_fd2_battle_item_effect_table ends exactly at 0x615FD (0x602AC + 215*23 = 0x615FD). All 72 bytes verified byte-identical between Ghidra memory @ 0x615FE and the C source array.
datatype: const uint8[72] (36 entries x 2 bytes; element type uint8, stride 2)
element_semantics: Per 2-byte entry indexed by (target_class_id - 0x20): byte[0] = post-promotion job_id assigned to the character (00h..1Ah job-id space; observed values 0x09..0x18, e.g. 0x09=SwordMaster/jian-sheng, 0x0B=HolyKnight/sheng-qi-shi, 0x13=DragonKnight/long-qi-shi); byte[1] = spell id learned on promotion, 0 = none, else a valid spell id (1 = lie-yan-shu, 2 = yan-long-shu, both real attack spells in the spell table). The last two entries (class 0x42 RuneWarrior, 0x43 Ninja) are alt-key-item-path-only promotions, reachable via the builder's +0x32 target path.
